text:
Tara: Quick plan check 1: microburst midday push + evening sustain for Gradient launch webinar. We're doing search + retarget + an interstitial on signup page. Thoughts? :sparkles:
Evan: Sounds good. Microburst = 2-hour high-intent window? Recommend 11:30-13:30 PT to catch east coast lunch + UK evening.
Priya: Yes 11:30-13:30 PT is good. For retargeting, we'll create a high-intent segment: visited pricing OR started signup OR watched >30s. Give it 2x bid vs baseline.
Leo: Creative ready: animated hero GIF + static fallback, 3 headline variants, 2 CTAs (Register / Request Demo). We should test hero motion vs static in the canary.
Nate: CRM mapping: prefer Intercom webhook for demo flows and HubSpot for marketing contacts. Can we send both? We'll dedupe by email+utm.
Hannah: Can we add a quick 2-option intent radio on the TY page (Webinar / Demo)? Sends property intent=webinar|demo to CRM.
Tara: Yes keep it 2 clicks. Also want a short nudge email for registrants 1 hour before webinar. Priya, can you wire the cadence?
Priya: On it. Also planning a mid-campaign creative refresh at +48h. We'll swap headlines that underperform CTR < 0.6%.
Evan: Budget pacing: propose baseline 15% for first 2h pre-burst, 100% for burst (2h), then 40% sustain for next 12h, then taper to 10% overnight. Also set a daily budget cap to avoid overspend.
Leo: A/B canary: UK (copy V1) at 8% traffic, AU (copy V2) at 8%, rest main. We'll randomize by cookie.
Nate: Offline conversions: please enable upload of webinar attendees to Ads platforms for signal. We'll post attendee list daily.
Tara: Ops checklist: 1) Tracking pixel fires on TY 2) intercom event name 'gradient_reg' 3) intent property captured 4) gclid and utm preserved 5) countdown visible mobile.
MarketingBot: deploy-window created: 2024-12-01T16:00:00Z (canary enabled).
Evan: Ads rule draft (will refine):
```
{
  "name": "gradient-midday-microburst",
  "windows": [
    {"start":"2024-12-04T11:30:00-08:00","end":"2024-12-04T13:30:00-08:00","multiplier":3.0},
    {"start":"2024-12-04T13:30:01-08:00","end":"2024-12-05T01:30:00-08:00","multiplier":0.4}
  ],
  "audience_overrides": {
    "high_intent": {"bid_mult": 2.0, "max_cpa": 160},
    "retarget_30d": {"bid_mult": 1.2}
  },
  "geo_limits": ["US","CA","UK","AU"],
  "daily_cap": 12000
}
```
Priya: We'll need audience list IDs and the creative IDs to attach. Upload creative filenames to the drive link: https://drive.redwood.com/gradient-midday-assets
Leo: I'll add animated + static versions with naming convention: gradient_hero_v1_anim.gif, gradient_hero_v1_static.jpg, headlineA.txt etc.
Nate: I'll provision Intercom webhook and add dedupe rule. Also setting a Slack fallback to #leads-live for high-quality leads.
Hannah: I'll build the 1-hour-before email template and a short reminder SMS for registrants who opted in.
Tara: One more: please enable burnout guard - if CPA > 220 for 2 consecutive hours, pause burst and notify #growth-alerts.
Evan: I'll add that rule.
Tara: Wrap-up: final creative + audience IDs + landing URLs posted by EOD tomorrow, 9am PT sync to confirm. Thanks all :raised_hands:
